# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to flawlessly fabricate and fashion non-magical cloth. All
required tools and materials must be present. The time to work the material is
halved.
@@ 2
Allows caster to flawlessly create non-magical leather (from animal skins).
All required tools and materials must be present. The time to work the
material is halved.
@@ 3
Allows caster to flawlessly work non-magical wood. All required tools and
materials must be present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 4
Allows caster to make a sheet of paper which will hold one first level spell.
Also allows caster to flawlessly make and work non-magical paper. All required
tools and materials must be present. The time to work the paper is halved.
@@ 5
Allows caster to work any non-magical organic material (e.g., horn, bone,
chitin, wax, feathers, hair, etc.). All required tools and materials must be
present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 6
As Rune Paper I, except the paper will hold a 1st or 2nd level spell.
@@ 7
Allows caster to make a “wand” which may have a 1st or 2nd level spell
imbedded in it using an imbedding spell.
@@ 8
As Rune Paper I, except the paper will hold a 1st, 2nd, or 3rd level spell.
@@ 10
Allows caster to make a “rod” which may have a first to fifth level spell
imbedded in it using an imbedding spell.
@@ 11
As Rune Paper I, except the paper will hold a 1st to 5th level spell.
@@ 13
When cast immediately before a Rune Paper spell, this allows a rune to be
placed upon any non-living organic material.
@@ 14
As Rune Paper I, except the paper will hold a 1st to 7th level spell.
@@ 15
Allows caster to make a “staff” which may have a 1st to 10th level spell
imbedded in it using an imbedding spell.
@@ 16
As Rune Paper I, except the paper will hold a 1st to 10th level spell.
@@ 17
Allows caster to flawlessly fabricate and fashion magical cloth. All required
tools and materials must be present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 18
Allows caster to flawlessly create magical leather (from animal skins). All
required tools and materials must be present. The time to work the material is
halved.
@@ 19
Allows caster to flawlessly work magical wood. All required tools and
materials must be present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 20
Allows caster to work any magical organic material (e.g., horn, bone, chitin,
wax, feathers, hair, etc.). All required tools and materials must be present.
The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 25
As Rune Paper I, except the paper will hold a 1st to 20th level spell.
@@ 30
As Rune Paper I, except the paper will hold a 1st to 30th level spell.
@@ 50
As Rune Paper I, except the paper will hold any level spell.
